qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High-specification subsea pipelay, SURF, and offshore wind installation fleet with strong project engineering, but through-cycle ROIC averages ~6-7%, failing the 12% threshold due to severe offshore capex cyclicality, high fixed vessel operating costs, and competitive contract bidding.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Highly asset-heavy offshore pipelay and SURF contractor with high operating leverage. Through-cycle ROIC averages ~6-7%, well below the 12% Munger hurdle, as downcycle vessel underutilization wipes out upcycle gains.
qualitative.evidence: Fleet of specialized pipelay and construction vessels requires heavy ongoing capital reinvestment. While upcycle EBIT margins can touch 11-15%, extended downcycles compress operating returns into low single digits or losses, keeping long-term median ROIC well below 12%.
